FIRST AMENDMENT
to Lease Agreement
by and between
Mr. Muhammad Ilyas Khan (the "Landlord") and Zameen Media (Private) Limited (the
"Zameen")
[Each a "Party" and, collectively, "Parties"]
This first amendment ("First Amendment") to the Lease Agreement dated 1st January, 2023
("Lease Agreement") is made and entered into at Lahore on this 3tbecember, 2023.
WHEREAS
(A)

The Parties entered into the Lease Agreement wherein the Lessor granted on lease, and
the Lessee took on lease from the Lessor, a commercial warehouse i.e. Hall No. 4
measuring forty-five hundred (4500) sq. ft, located at Ali Park, Peco Road, Kot Lakhpat,
Lahore ("Demised Premises"); and

(B)

The Parties hereby mutually agree to revise and amend the Lease Agreement as per the
terms and conditions of this First Amendment.

NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows:
1.

The First Amendment shall come into force on 1st January, 2024 ("Effective Date").

2.

Pursuant to Clause 1.1 of the Lease Agreement, the Parties hereby mutually agree to
extend the term of the Lease Agreement for a period of one (1) year, commencing from the
Effective Date and ending on 31st December, 2024 ("Extended Term").

3.

All other terms and provisions in the Lease Agreement shall mutatis mutandis apply and
shall continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the
event of any conflict, the terms of this First Amendment shall prevail, and any conflicting
term in the Lease Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately.

4.

This First Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Lease Agreement.

5.

All expressions and terms defined or used in the Lease Agreement shall bear the same
meaning in this First Amendment, unless otherwise specified herein.

6.

This First Amendment may be entered into in counterparts, all of which taken together shall
constitute one and the same amendment.

FIRST AMENDMENT
to Consultancy Agreement
by and between
Zameen Media (Private) Limited (the "Zameen") and Mr. Muhammad Ali Ilyas Khan (the
"Consultant")

[Each a "Party" and, collectively, "Parties"]

This first amendment (the "First Amendment") to the Consultancy Agreement dated 1st January, 2023
(the "Agreement"), is made and entered into at Lahore on this 6th day of December, 2023.

WHEREAS
(A)

The Parties entered into the Agreement wherein the Zameen acquired services for
management of a warehouse leased by Zameen located at Hall No. 6, Ali Park, Peco Road,
Kot Lakhpat, Lahore on such terms and conditions as agreed in writing between the Parties
from time to time; and

(B)

The Parties hereby mutually agree to revise and amend the Agreement as per the terms and
conditions of this First Amendment.

NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows:
1.

The First Amendment shall come into force on 1st January, 2024 (the "Effective Date").

2.

Pursuant to Clause 1.1 of the Lease Agreement, the Parties hereby mutually agree to extend
the term of the Agreement for a period of one (1) year, commencing from the Effective Date and
ending on 31st December, 2024 ("Extended Term").

3.

The Parties agree that, during the Extended Term the revised consultancy fee shall be Rs.
60,500 (Rupees Sixty Thousand Five Hundred) per month inclusive of all taxes (the
"Consultancy Fee").

4.

This First Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Agreement.

5.

All other terms and provisions in the Agreement shall mutatis mutandis apply and shall continue
in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the event of any
conflict, the terms of this First Amendment shall prevail, and any conflicting term in the
Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately.

6.

All expressions and terms defined or used in the Agreement shall bear the same meaning in this
First Amendment, unless otherwise specified herein.

7.

This First Amendment may be entered into in counterparts, all of which taken together shall
constitute one and the same amendment.
